__purpose_en: Gold Standard Mind Map Example File
__description: 本文件展示评估框架所要求的金标准导图数据格式，供开发者和标注者参考。所有注释严格遵循中英双语独立成行规范。
__description_en: This file demonstrates the gold standard mind map data format required by the evaluation framework, for developer and annotator reference. All annotations strictly follow the bilingual separate-line convention.

nodes.label: 机器学习基础
nodes.__note: 根节点，代表整个思维导图的中心主题
nodes.__note_en: Root node, representing the central topic of the entire mind map

metadata.__note_en: Root node type, no parent node

nodes.label: 监督学习
nodes.__note: 第1层子节点，代表机器学习的三大范式之一
nodes.__note_en: Level 1 child node, representing one of the three major paradigms of machine learning
details: 监督学习使用带标签的训练数据，学习从输入到输出的映射函数
Supervised learning uses labeled training data to learn a mapping function from input to output

nodes.label: 无监督学习
nodes.__note: 第1层子节点，处理无标签数据的机器学习范式
nodes.__note_en: Level 1 child node, a machine learning paradigm for unlabeled data
details: 无监督学习从未标注的数据中发现隐藏的模式和结构
Unsupervised learning discovers hidden patterns and structures from unlabeled data

nodes.label: 强化学习
nodes.__note: 第1层子节点，通过与环境的交互和奖励信号来学习最优策略
nodes.__note_en: Level 1 child node, learning optimal policies through interaction with the environment and reward signals
details: 强化学习通过智能体与环境的交互，最大化累积奖励
Reinforcement learning maximizes cumulative rewards through agent-environment interaction

nodes.label: 线性回归
nodes.__note: 第2层叶子节点，监督学习中的基础回归算法
nodes.__note_en: Level 2 leaf node, a fundamental regression algorithm in supervised learning
details: 利用最小二乘法拟合线性模型
Uses ordinary least squares to fit a linear model
适用于预测连续值的任务，如房价预测
Suitable for predicting continuous values, such as house price prediction

nodes.label: 支持向量机
nodes.__note: 第2层叶子节点，基于最大间隔分类的监督学习算法
nodes.__note_en: Level 2 leaf node, a supervised learning algorithm based on maximum margin classification
details: 通过寻找最大间隔超平面来进行分类
Performs classification by finding the maximum-margin hyperplane
支持核技巧，可处理非线性分类问题
Supports kernel trick for handling non-linear classification problems

nodes.label: 决策树
nodes.__note: 第2层叶子节点，基于树结构的可解释分类与回归模型
nodes.__note_en: Level 2 leaf node, an interpretable tree-structured model for classification and regression
details: 通过树状决策规则对数据进行划分
Partitions data through tree-structured decision rules
具有良好的可解释性，可直观展示决策路径
Has good interpretability, can visually display decision paths

nodes.label: K-Means聚类
nodes.__note: 第2层叶子节点，无监督学习中最常用的聚类算法之一
nodes.__note_en: Level 2 leaf node, one of the most commonly used clustering algorithms in unsupervised learning
details: 通过迭代优化将数据划分为K个簇
Partitions data into K clusters through iterative optimization
使用欧氏距离衡量样本之间的相似度
Uses Euclidean distance to measure similarity between samples

nodes.label: 主成分分析
nodes.__note: 第2层叶子节点，无监督学习中的经典降维方法
nodes.__note_en: Level 2 leaf node, a classic dimensionality reduction method in unsupervised learning
details: 通过线性变换将高维数据映射到低维空间
Maps high-dimensional data to a lower-dimensional space via linear transformation
保留数据中方差最大的方向作为主成分
Preserves the directions of maximum variance as principal components

nodes.label: Q-Learning
nodes.__note: 第2层叶子节点，强化学习中基于价值的经典算法
nodes.__note_en: Level 2 leaf node, a classic value-based algorithm in reinforcement learning
details: 通过Q函数估计状态-动作对的价值
Estimates the value of state-action pairs through the Q-function
使用贝尔曼方程迭代更新Q值
Uses the Bellman equation to iteratively update Q-values

nodes.label: 策略梯度
nodes.__note: 第2层叶子节点，强化学习中基于策略的优化方法
nodes.__note_en: Level 2 leaf node, a policy-based optimization method in reinforcement learning
details: 直接对策略函数进行参数化并优化
Directly parameterizes and optimizes the policy function
适用于连续动作空间和高维状态空间
Suitable for continuous action spaces and high-dimensional state spaces

__notes.purpose: 本文件是一个金标准导图（Gold Standard Mind Map）的完整示例，用于展示评估框架所要求的数据格式。开发者可以参照此文件的结构创建自己的金标准数据。
__notes.purpose_en: This file is a complete example of a Gold Standard Mind Map, demonstrating the data format required by the evaluation framework. Developers can follow this file structure to create their own gold standard data.

id.__format: 小写字母加下划线，同一文件中唯一
id.__format_en: Lowercase letters with underscores, unique within the same file

label.__format: 中文或英文文本，与课程中的概念名称保持一致
label.__format_en: Chinese or English text, consistent with the concept name in the lecture

parent_id.__format: 根节点的parent_id为null；子节点的parent_id必须对应一个已存在的节点id
parent_id.__format_en: Root node's parent_id is null; child node's parent_id must reference an existing node id

details.__format: 字符串数组，每两个条构成一组中英双语说明。第一行为中文，第二行为对应的英文。可选字段，不必须包含。
details.__format_en: String array. Every two entries form a bilingual pair: first is Chinese, second is English. Optional field, not required.

__note.__format: 用中文描述该节点的含义、作用或注意事项。仅用于文档说明，评估工具不会解析此字段。
__note.__format_en: Describes the node's meaning, purpose, or notes in Chinese. For documentation only, the evaluation tool does not parse this field.

__note_en.__format: 用英文描述该节点的含义、作用或注意事项。仅用于文档说明，评估工具不会解析此字段。
__note_en.__format_en: Describes the node's meaning, purpose, or notes in English. For documentation only, the evaluation tool does not parse this field.

metadata.__format: 包含depth（层级深度）和type（节点类型：root/category/algorithm）等辅助信息。可选字段。
metadata.__format_en: Contains auxiliary information such as depth (hierarchy depth) and type (node type: root/category/algorithm). Optional field.

links.__format: 每条边包含source（父节点id）和target（子节点id）。可从节点的parent_id字段自动推导。用于与modify_mind_map输出格式保持一致。
links.__format_en: Each edge contains source (parent id) and target (child id). Can be auto-derived from nodes' parent_id fields. Present for compatibility with modify_mind_map output format.

tree.__format: G6前端消费的嵌套树格式，根节点通过children字段递归包含子树。与modify_mind_map输出的tree字段一致。
tree.__format_en: G6 frontend nested tree format. Root nodes recursively contain subtrees via children field. Consistent with the tree field in modify_mind_map output.

creation_guidelines.__title_en: How to Create a Gold Standard Mind Map
creation_guidelines.step_1: 1. 从课程讲义或逐字稿中提取所有关键概念
creation_guidelines.step_1_en: 1. Extract all key concepts from the lecture notes or transcript
creation_guidelines.step_2: 2. 确定概念之间的父子层级关系，构建树结构
creation_guidelines.step_2_en: 2. Determine the parent-child hierarchical relationships between concepts and build a tree structure
creation_guidelines.step_3: 3. 为每个节点分配唯一的id和描述性的label
creation_guidelines.step_3_en: 3. Assign a unique id and descriptive label to each node
creation_guidelines.step_4: 4. 可选：为重要节点添加details详情说明
creation_guidelines.step_4_en: 4. Optional: Add detail descriptions for important nodes
creation_guidelines.step_5: 5. 验证树的完整性：根节点存在、所有节点可达、无循环依赖
creation_guidelines.step_5_en: 5. Verify tree integrity: root exists, all nodes reachable, no circular dependencies

common_mistakes.mistake_1: 1. 缺少根节点：每个导图必须有且仅有一个根节点（parent_id为null）
common_mistakes.mistake_1_en: 1. Missing root node: each mind map must have exactly one root node (parent_id is null)
common_mistakes.mistake_2: 2. 孤立的节点：某个节点的parent_id指向了不存在的id
common_mistakes.mistake_2_en: 2. Orphaned node: a node's parent_id references a non-existent id
common_mistakes.mistake_3: 3. 标签不一致：同一概念在不同节点中使用不同的命名方式
common_mistakes.mistake_3_en: 3. Inconsistent labels: the same concept uses different naming across nodes
common_mistakes.mistake_4: 4. 层级过深或过浅：一般建议3-5层深度，避免超过7层
common_mistakes.mistake_4_en: 4. Depth too deep or shallow: generally recommend 3-5 levels, avoid exceeding 7 levels
